import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I've written the plan for making `=` flip relation direction and submitted it for your review. It's validated and staged, and nothing changes until you approve it.

**What `=` will do**

| You type | Today | With the plan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `=` in an open Links To picker | `=` goes into the filter | Flips to Linked From (`~~`) |
| `=` in an open Linked From picker | `=` goes into the filter | Flips back to Links To (`~`) |
| `Fix it -` then `=` | `~=`, picker opens filtering on `=` | `Fix it ~~`, Linked From opens |
| `Fix it ~` then a quick `=` | `~=`, picker opens filtering on `=` | `Fix it ~~`, Linked From opens |
| `Fix it -` then `-` | `Fix it --` | Still `Fix it --` |

**It needs two parts, not just a picker key.** Inside the open picker, `=` simply runs the same flip `~` already uses. That part only touches Bob Mac Capture. But the picker appears about 300 ms after the `~` lands, because `bob capture-complete` alone takes about 250 ms on athena. Since `-` and `=` are next to each other on the keyboard, a quick `-=` will usually type `=` into the editor before the picker exists. Bob has to make that call, so the plan adds a small `capture-rewrite` alias in bob-cli:
- `=` right after a bare `~` that opens Links To becomes `~~`.
- `-=` where the `-` would have become `~` turns into `~~`.
- Everywhere else, `=` stays as typed: after `~~`, inside wikilinks, glued to text, and in `x`/`=name` items.

The Mac forwards `=` only when the character before it is `~` or `-`. It applies Bob's change the same way it handles the `-` and `,` shortcuts, so Undo gives you back the literal `~=` or `-=`. With an older bob, the flip inside the picker still works, and `=` typed in the editor just stays literal.

The picker hint will read "~ or = flips direction". The plan also covers tests and docs in both repos, with bob-cli landing first.

**One choice when you review (`filter_scope`):** should `=` flip direction even after you've typed some search text, like `~` does? I defaulted to yes, which means you can't search relation targets for a literal `=`. The alternative flips only while the filter is still empty.

The Obsidian Task Card's relation filter, where `~` also flips, isn't covered. It would be a separate change in `bob-plugins` if you want it.
